advisory_only_no_execution: ADVISORY ONLY · no automatic execution or broker order.
allocation_clamped: The formal strategy bounds limited the effective adjustment
allocation_input_help: Enter gold as a percentage of investable assets. Saving creates a new immutable user snapshot and never runs a model or places an order.
allocation_missing_notice: The formal pp recommendation remains visible, but no target weight is invented until you enter your current gold allocation.
allocation_save_failed: The allocation snapshot could not be saved.
allocation_snapshot_saved: A new append-only allocation snapshot was saved.
allocation_stale_confirm: Please confirm this allocation; the snapshot may be stale.
allocation_update_principle: You do not need to enter this every day. Save it once initially, then update it only after an actual buy or sell, a meaningful portfolio-weight drift, or a stale-snapshot warning. If you did not execute the advice, do not change the snapshot. Before acting on ADD or REDUCE, first confirm that the reported weight is current.
api_key_replace_hint: Enter a new key to replace the current one
conditional_price_advisory: Conditional price scenario only; it is not an action threshold and does not control a fill.
conditional_price_role_strict: If this direction occurs, the price scenario supports expectations and risk/reward review only; it never changes the action.
conditional_price_unavailable: The MN18 probabilities and action remain available, but the PN02 conditional price expectation is temporarily unavailable.
confirm_key_delete: Confirm deletion of the current key
confirm_paid_refresh: I understand that downloading historical Databento data may incur usage charges.
connection_error: The local backend is unreachable. Confirm that the AuPilot Docker services are running, then refresh this page.
cost_method_note: Cost method: weighted average. Monetary P&L uses price difference × quantity × contract multiplier − fees.
credential_tools_help: Verification, paid refresh and key deletion operate only on the saved configuration.
credential_tools_pending: Save or discard pending switch/key changes before using these operations.
databento_refresh_required: The Databento key is configured, but no fresh verified daily cache is available.
databento_setup_required: Databento is required for new UTC buckets and new MN18/PN02 issuances. Until a key is configured, the verified cache remains read-only.
disclaimer: Analysis and conditional scenarios only. Not investment advice. AuPilot never places orders, shorts gold, or adds leverage.
dual_model_forward_shadow_warning: MN18/PN02 is an exposed full-development candidate pending new forward-shadow evidence; no performance claim is made.
formal_market_unavailable: Verified Databento daily market data is unavailable. No sample or Yahoo fallback is displayed.
future_not_current_action: Future forecast only; this is not a currently scheduled buy or sell.
homepage_advice_description: Review the persisted MN18 H1 action, complete seven-class probabilities, 21 UTC slots and advisory PN02 conditional OHLC scenarios.
homepage_flow_action_body: MN18 returns HOLD or REDUCE_GOLD_WEIGHT for the immediate H1 slot. A frozen H2 BOTTOM request can become REENTER_GOLD_WEIGHT only when the receiver policy settles its own target bucket against FIFO inventory.
homepage_flow_data_body: Verified Databento GC.v.0 UTC daily history, complete through the latest closed bucket.
homepage_flow_issuance_body: Input cutoff, model identity, issue time and output hash are persisted before realization.
homepage_flow_outlook_body: Twenty-one-slot MN18 probabilities and PN02 conditional OHLC provide context without overriding the action.
homepage_flow_responsibility: MN18 alone controls technical requests. PN02 prices and macro/RAG are advisory; they never create, cancel, or resize a technical action.
homepage_flow_state_body: Features and path state use only information available at or before the source day.
homepage_flow_validation_body: Later market outcomes attach to the immutable issuance without rewriting its forecast.
homepage_footer_disclaimer: Research and decision-support tool only. Nothing on this site constitutes investment advice.
homepage_footer_performance: Future returns are not guaranteed. Historical or development-stage results do not represent future performance.
homepage_gold_description: Inspect verified Databento gold UTC daily candles and technical states calculated from the same official OHLC history.
homepage_guardrail_causal_body: Technical features are derived from formal daily information available no later than the source date.
homepage_guardrail_execution_body: AuPilot does not connect to brokers, place orders, short gold or add leverage. Probabilities and prices are not return promises.
homepage_guardrail_isolation_body: Macro risk supports awareness only; it cannot alter technical outputs, tests, tuning or action authority.
homepage_guardrail_issuance_body: Issue time, input cutoff, model identity and output hash prevent present-day recalculation from posing as history.
homepage_guardrails_body: The product favors traceability and explicit limits over unsupported certainty.
homepage_guardrails_title: What the system proves, and what it refuses to imply
homepage_macro_audit_body: Availability time, freshness and citations are checked before the assessment is supported.
homepage_macro_description: Read official, timestamped evidence and an independent five-level event-risk assessment that never enters technical decisions.
homepage_macro_isolation: Isolation rule: macro content, risk bands and interpretations never feed the technical model, action state machine, backtest or tuning path.
homepage_macro_lane_title: Official event risk, kept outside the technical model
homepage_macro_risk_body: The separate radar communicates event proximity, impact and relevance without producing a trade action.
homepage_macro_source_body: Federal Reserve, New York Fed, U.S. Treasury, BLS, BEA and optional FRED/ALFRED evidence only.
homepage_products_body: Move from verified daily market context to read-only technical advice, independent macro awareness and issuance-based validation.
homepage_products_title: Four focused views, one auditable workflow
homepage_subtitle: Preserve long-term gold exposure while using traceable daily signals for measured reductions and additions.
homepage_system_body: MN18 probabilities/actions and PN02 conditional prices have separate responsibilities and share the same causal Databento UTC daily input boundary.
homepage_system_title: From one canonical daily history to a traceable product issuance
homepage_title: Tactical rebalancing and risk intelligence for long-term gold holders
homepage_validation_description: Inspect immutable prior issuances and realized status. Performance conclusions stay withheld until evidence is sufficient.
interval_unavailable: The marginal interval is temporarily unavailable.
macro_body: A read-only five-level view of official FOMC, rates, CPI, PCE and payroll evidence, isolated from technical decisions.
macro_cancel_supported: Evidence is sufficient; the highest external macro-event risk window is active.
macro_caution_unsupported: Required evidence is missing, stale or conflicting. CAUTION is a data-quality floor, not a measured event-risk result.
macro_informational_disclaimer: Informational only. No bullish/bearish direction, trade permission, technical-model input, decision-engine input, order, position, price forecast or profit-tuning signal is provided.
macro_interpretation_audit: Deterministic explanation · does not affect risk, the technical model or trade permission
macro_interpretation_disclaimer: Generated by auditable deterministic rules from the cited facts. It does not score the event, change the five-level risk, enter the technical model, or grant trade permission.
macro_no_citations: No eligible official citations are available.
macro_risk_scale_help: The highlighted band is current. Time is the base indicator; deterministic event-class impact and rate-chain relevance may raise pre-release risk by one band. No market surprise is inferred.
macro_source_disable_semantics: Each macro switch is authoritative. After the global save, a disabled source is excluded from the calendar and evidence pool and treated by the backend as unavailable. Remaining eligible official evidence can still support a degraded assessment; only when every source is disabled or no eligible official evidence remains does macro risk become CAUTION / data missing. A confirmed HOLD or CANCEL risk is never lowered merely because another source is unavailable.
macro_summary_unavailable: No accepted official facts are available. The system cannot provide a reliable plain-language interpretation.
macro_supported: Assessment supported by the current official evidence snapshot
macro_unsupported: CAUTION (DATA MISSING): the current snapshot cannot support a reliable assessment
marginal_interval_notice: The 80% ranges are per-field marginal intervals, not an 80% joint confidence region for the whole candle.
market_refresh_failed: Databento market refresh failed. The previous verified cache, if any, was not replaced.
no_conditional_signals_21: None of the current 21 slots has a displayable TOP/BOTTOM signal. Conditional prices remain hidden rather than being presented as unconditional forecasts.
no_mock_fallback: Formal output never falls back to Mock, Yahoo, sample data, or retrospective reconstruction.
no_transactions: No transaction records match the filters.
normal_lightweight_detail: Normal state; no conditional price scenario is displayed.
normal_no_price: No turning-point action signal; conditional price hidden
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed. Review the inputs or backend logs and try again.
overview_body: Inspect official Databento UTC daily gold OHLC and locally calculated technical indicators.
page_get_no_model_run: This page reads persisted issuances only and does not run MN18 or PN02 in the browser.
plaintext_key_warning: Test version: API keys are stored as plaintext in the local file shown below.
position_body: Current holdings are reconstructed from the append-only ledger. Settings remain read-only until you open the settings dialog.
position_settings_help: Open a protected form. Nothing changes until Save and apply is submitted.
pp_not_multiplier: Percentage points are added to the user-reported weight; they are not a percentage multiplier.
pre_forward_preview_notice: This is a real dual-model product preview based on the latest complete post-training bucket. It is not counted as a compliant forward-shadow record.
price_trend_help: The chart describes historical data; it is not a future-return promise.
record_transaction_help: Record a completed historical trade only; the system never sends an order.
settings_history_help: Each save creates a new immutable version.
settings_saved: A new settings version was created.
seven_class_always_visible: The full H1 distribution is always visible; TOP and BOTTOM are grouped by three strength levels.
source_bea_cost: Official API and RSS; requirements depend on the endpoint.
source_bls_cost: A free registration key can increase the official API quota.
source_databento_cost: A Databento account and applicable data plan are required.
source_databento_purpose: Gold market prices and formal model input.
source_federal_reserve_cost: Official public source; normally no key.
source_federal_reserve_purpose: FOMC calendar and official policy releases.
source_fred_cost: Optional; API calls require a FRED key.
source_fred_purpose: Optional official cross-check for rates and initial values.
source_new_york_fed_cost: Official public source; normally no key.
source_no_unsaved_changes: All switches and keys match the saved configuration.
source_settings_save_failed: Nothing was saved. Review the data-source settings and try again.
source_settings_saved: Saved. All switches and newly entered keys are now active.
source_settings_scope: Edit all switches and keys first. Nothing changes until you save the full data-source configuration.
source_us_treasury_cost: Official public source; normally no key.
source_verification_failed: Databento metadata verification failed. Check the key, dataset access and network.
strength_color_legend: Turning-point strength color legend: L1 to L3 runs from dark to bright
technical_contract_invalid: The persisted response does not satisfy the frozen MN18/PN02 21-slot contract.
technical_issuance_stale: The latest successful technical issuance is stale
technical_issuance_unavailable: MN18 and PN02 are loaded and verified. A compliant forward issuance will appear after the next eligible UTC source bucket is complete and passes all gates.
technical_snapshot_note: All values are calculated locally from the same verified Databento daily OHLCV snapshot. They describe history and do not constitute a trade instruction.
today_advice_body: Read the persisted H1 action, personalize its percentage-point adjustment, and inspect 21 valid UTC daily forecast slots.
transaction_history_help: Voided facts remain traceable and are excluded from accounting.
transaction_warning: Only record facts that already occurred. Selling more than the available bucket is rejected.
validation_buy_hold_return_help: Same evidence period and initial capital.
validation_chart_contract: Verified MN18 development OOS covers {start} through {end}; the strategy deducts {cost:g} bps per side. Cash, gold quantity, target weight, NAV and time axis continue without reset through the passive bridge and later compliant forward records.
validation_combined_evidence_badge: Verified MN18 development OOS + passive market bridge + compliant forward log · not independent final validation
validation_cost_policy: All portfolio calculations use 2 bps transaction cost per side and no additional implicit slippage.
validation_data_unavailable: The verified Databento market cache or technical issuance log is unavailable.
validation_equity_comparison: Cumulative return · model vs buy and hold
validation_latest_market_bucket_help: Latest completed canonical GC UTC daily bucket available to the product.
validation_marker_toggle_help: All 701 qualified MN18 requests are shown by default; unfilled requests remain visible while only the 186 actual 2 bps trades alter the historical portfolio curve. Macro/RAG never creates a marker.
validation_model_candidate_help: Development candidate; independent final validation is not claimed.
validation_model_return_help: Strict H1 strategy with 2 bps transaction cost deducted per side.
validation_one_bucket_lag: Up to one complete UTC bucket of delay is allowed
validation_oos_boundary_label: Training cutoff · real-world unseen data begins
validation_oos_help: The dashed line is the 2026-07-21 training-data cutoff. Verified development OOS ends there; later complete bars are passive mark-to-market until the first compliant forward issuance, with no historical MN18 reconstruction.
validation_phase_contract: MN18 training data ends on {cutoff}. The interval after it remains a no-signal passive mark-to-market bridge until compliant forward records begin at {unseen_start}; latest compliant source: {unseen_end}.
validation_pipeline_current_help: All hashes pass and the latest complete market bucket is no more than one bucket behind.
validation_pipeline_waiting_help: The chain failed verification, formal market data is stale, or the combined evidence timeline is unavailable.
validation_refresh_complete: Refresh verified through {latest}. New complete market buckets: {market}; new compliant forward records: {records}; new model runs: {runs}; processed source buckets: {buckets}. The passive bridge and combined hash were recalculated.
validation_refresh_failed: Refresh failed closed. No Mock, Yahoo, legacy model, macro/RAG input or future-looking result was added.
validation_refreshing: Verifying evidence hashes, refreshing formal Databento bars and processing any eligible MN18 forward source bucket…
validation_return_lift_help: Model strategy return minus buy-and-hold return.
validation_runtime_help: The chain is current only when formal Databento data, frozen MN18/PN02 hashes, persisted outputs and the combined timeline hash all verify. Macro/RAG is excluded.
validation_signal_fill_count_help: Qualified MN18 requests / actual 2 bps trades in the verified development OOS evidence, plus later compliant forward activity when available.
validation_trust_body: Verify that the deployed MN18/PN02 chain is running on formal market data, then review verified development OOS evidence, the passive post-cutoff bridge and compliant forward records.
validation_unseen_daily_record_count_hel: The first value is append-only compliant MN18 forward issuances; the second is realized forward-shadow rebalances. The passive bridge never fabricates model signals.
